# generated by tools/territory.py (spec 75): territorial claims and border disputes for every country
TU_territory_category = {

	# 1. Claim the border states of a neighbour.
	TU_terr_claim = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_nationalism
		allowed = { always = yes }

		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { original_tag = WLD }
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				is_neighbor_of = ROOT
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
				NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
				any_owned_state = {
					is_controlled_by = FROM
					any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_claimed_by = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
					impassable = no
				}
			}
		}

		available = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
		}

		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 180

		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = TU_terr_claim_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = {
					every_owned_state = {
						limit = {
							is_controlled_by = FROM
					any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_claimed_by = ROOT }
					NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
					impassable = no
						}
						add_claim_by = ROOT
					}
					country_event = { id = tu_terr.1 }
				}
			}
			FROM = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TU_terr_claim_op } }
			add_threat = 2
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_government = democratic }
			modifier = { factor = 0 strength_ratio = { tag = FROM ratio < 0.8 } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 OR = { has_government = fascism has_government = communism } }
		}
	}

	# 2. Escalate: a war goal for the claimed states.
	TU_terr_dispute = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_operation
		allowed = { always = yes }

		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { original_tag = WLD }
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
				any_owned_state = { is_claimed_by = ROOT }
			}
		}

		available = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
			has_war_support > 0.19
		}

		cost = 75
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 365

		complete_effect = {
			create_wargoal = { type = take_claimed_state target = FROM }
			FROM = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TU_terr_dispute_op }
				country_event = { id = tu_terr.2 }
			}
			add_threat = 4
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_government = democratic }
			modifier = { factor = 0 strength_ratio = { tag = FROM ratio < 1.1 } }
		}
	}

	# 3. Settle: drop every claim on their land.
	TU_terr_treaty = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_political_discourse
		allowed = { always = yes }

		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				NOT = { original_tag = WLD }
				NOT = { tag = ROOT }
				any_owned_state = {
					is_claimed_by = ROOT
					NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
				}
			}
		}

		available = {
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
		}

		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		days_re_enable = 180

		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = TU_terr_treaty_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				FROM = {
					every_owned_state = {
						limit = {
							is_claimed_by = ROOT
							NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
						}
						remove_claim_by = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = FROM modifier = TU_terr_treaty_op }
			FROM = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = TU_terr_treaty_op } }
			add_stability = 0.02
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 1 has_government = democratic }
		}
	}

	# 4. Integrate: claimed states we own become cores.
	TU_terr_integrate = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_construction
		allowed = { always = yes }

		visible = {
			any_owned_state = {
				is_claimed_by = ROOT
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
				is_controlled_by = ROOT
			}
		}

		cost = 100
		fire_only_once = no
		days_remove = 180

		modifier = {
			stability_factor = -0.03
		}

		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = TU_terr_integrate_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				every_owned_state = {
					limit = {
						is_claimed_by = ROOT
						NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
					}
					add_core_of = ROOT
				}
			}
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5
		}
	}
}
